target_customer: Mobile-first engineering teams shipping high consequence apps and using coding agents
problem: AI made building apps fast but QA, design, accessibility, compliance and store policy checks still slow every release.
business_model: B2B SaaS of AI expert agents per build or team (pricing not public)
product_category: AI mobile app testing and certification

founders.name: Vivek Soneja
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

founders.name: Rajesh Kumar
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, patented automated payments testing.

competitors.name: QA Wolf
competitors.what: Agentic end to end testing producing Playwright or Appium code

competitors.name: Autosana
competitors.what: Agentic QA for iOS, Android and web apps

competitors.name: Drizz
competitors.what: Vision based AI mobile app testing agent

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that explore apps and judge accessibility and store policy need device automation and reliable verdicts; standard engineering with hard evaluation problems.

defensibility.rationale: Stored team expectations and release gates create some lock in, but many funded entrants exist and the approach is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crowded; no incumbent action against Aucert reported.

market_need_then: AI coding sped up app creation, raising demand for automated verification; rivals raised funds in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses aucert.ai; no domain history found.

identity.logo: Wordmark with dark and light variants
identity.mascot_or_character: Agent personas named Pax (policy), Iris (accessibility) and Genie (explorer)
identity.visual_style: Founder credibility and customer logos lead
identity.voice_and_tone: Short fragments, headlines ending in periods, playful one line personas

brand_strength.rationale: Persona idea is distinctive but only a Fondo write-up covers it; name resembles AICerts and similar certification brands.

outcome_analysis: Aucert is a two person Fall 2026 company launched in the batch, with senior mobile engineers from Meta, PhonePe and PayPal as founders. There is no exit or failure. Its outcome depends on whether agent verdicts are trusted enough to gate releases and on beating better known testing vendors.
notes: Dealroom lists only a $125k seed with locked details, unverified and consistent with YC standard terms, not recorded as a round. Competitor dates are of recent sources; Aucert batch is Fall 2026 so as_of is approximate.
